scope: Aggregate diagnostics on configured local database; no production inference and no business identifiers

checks.name: rowCounts
checks.sql: SELECT 'sales_orders' AS source,count(*)::text AS rows FROM sales_orders UNION ALL SELECT 'payments',count(*)::text FROM payments UNION ALL SELECT 'journal_entries',count(*)::text FROM journal_entries UNION ALL SELECT 'inventory_transactions',count(*)::text FROM inventory_transactions UNION ALL SELECT 'supplier_invoices',count(*)::text FROM supplier_invoices UNION ALL SELECT 'supplier_payments',count(*)::text FROM supplier_payments UNION ALL SELECT 'payroll_runs',count(*)::text FROM payroll_runs UNION ALL SELECT 'reconciliation_runs',count(*)::text FROM reconciliation_runs UNION ALL SELECT 'pos_offline_events',count(*)::text FROM pos_offline_events

checks.name: journalBalance
checks.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS unbalanced_posted_entry_currency_groups FROM (SELECT l."journalEntryId",l.currency FROM journal_entry_lines l JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id=l."journalEntryId" WHERE j.status::text IN ('POSTED','REVERSED') GROUP BY l."journalEntryId",l.currency HAVING sum(l.debit)<>sum(l.credit)) s

checks.name: journalTenant
checks.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS inconsistent_line_entry_account_tenants FROM journal_entry_lines l JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id=l."journalEntryId" JOIN chart_of_accounts a ON a.id=l."accountId" WHERE l."organizationId"<>j."organizationId" OR l."organizationId"<>a."organizationId"

checks.name: journalBase
checks.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS non_unit_rate_lines,count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(coalesce("baseDebit",0)-round(debit*"exchangeRate",2))>0.01 OR abs(coalesce("baseCredit",0)-round(credit*"exchangeRate",2))>0.01)::text AS candidate_base_conversion_mismatches FROM journal_entry_lines WHERE "exchangeRate"<>1

checks.name: journalCurrencies
checks.sql: SELECT currency,count(*)::text AS lines FROM journal_entry_lines GROUP BY currency ORDER BY currency

checks.name: journalSources
checks.sql: SELECT "sourceType"::text,status::text,count(*)::text AS entries FROM journal_entries GROUP BY "sourceType",status ORDER BY "sourceType",status

checks.name: journalLink
checks.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS posted_without_posting_batch FROM journal_entries WHERE status::text IN ('POSTED','REVERSED') AND "postingBatchId" IS NULL

checks.name: inventoryTenant
checks.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS inconsistent_item_location_tenants FROM inventory_levels v JOIN items i ON i.id=v."itemId" JOIN locations l ON l.id=v."locationId" WHERE i."organizationId"<>l."organizationId"

checks.name: inventoryProjection
checks.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS levels,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "quantityAvailable"<>"quantityOnHand"-"quantityReserved")::text AS available_mismatches,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "quantityOnHand"<0 OR "quantityReserved"<0 OR "quantityAvailable"<0)::text AS negative_levels,count(*) FILTER(WHERE abs("totalValue"-round("quantityOnHand"*"averageCost",2))>0.01)::text AS valuation_rounding_candidates FROM inventory_levels

checks.name: payrollArithmetic
checks.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS runs,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "netPayableAmount"<>"grossAmount"-"employeeDeductionAmount")::text AS arithmetic_mismatches FROM payroll_runs

checks.name: payrollRegister
checks.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS emitted_run_total_mismatches FROM payroll_runs r JOIN (SELECT "payrollRunId",sum("grossAmount") AS gross,sum("netPayableAmount") AS net FROM payroll_payslips WHERE status::text<>'VOIDED' GROUP BY "payrollRunId") p ON p."payrollRunId"=r.id WHERE r.status::text IN ('EMITTED','POSTED','ARCHIVED') AND (p.gross<>r."grossAmount" OR p.net<>r."netPayableAmount")

checks.name: salesPaymentTenant
checks.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS inconsistent_sale_payment_tenants FROM payments p JOIN sales_orders s ON s.id=p."salesOrderId" WHERE p."organizationId"<>s."organizationId"

checks.name: periodOverlap
checks.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS overlapping_period_pairs FROM accounting_periods a JOIN accounting_periods b ON a."organizationId"=b."organizationId" AND a.id<b.id AND a."startDate"<=b."endDate" AND b."startDate"<=a."endDate"

checks.name: fiscalBounds
checks.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS periods_outside_fiscal_year FROM accounting_periods p JOIN fiscal_years f ON f.id=p."fiscalYearId" WHERE p."startDate"<f."startDate" OR p."endDate">f."endDate"
